## Purpose

Describe the observable problem and the focused solution.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests fail without the change and pass with it.
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] Coverage and package build pass.
- [ ] Public schema or behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] Test data is synthetic and safe to publish.
- [ ] Substantial automated assistance is disclosed.

## Compatibility and risk

List affected inputs, outputs, exit codes, and migration needs.
